status_note: WORKPKG-UNMAP-STRFOLD-0006 bilateral fixture: the real RuleStringCopy::applyOp drives the full StringSequence chain (ctor getSubType walk, collectCopyOps, checkInterference, formByteArray, constructTypedPointer, buildStringCopy, removeForward/removeCopyOps, transform) on the locked oracle BfdArchitecture and the pinned Rugra snapshot; the internal strings are read back through the architecture's real StringManager (registerInternalStringData cache hit at the STRINGDATA hash).

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: StringSequence ctor takes the container SymbolEntry as a read-only projection (getAddr space, getFirst, getSize, getSymbol->getType); transform mutates the Funcdata only; constructTypedPointer returns the newly created spacePtr Varnode after per-level updateType(getTypePointerStripArray); removeCopyOps redefines surviving read-point Varnodes in place via opSetOutput(INDIRECT) rather than creating replacement Varnodes.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: collectCopyOps iterates the VarnodeLocSet closed span [beginLoc(beginAddr)..endLoc(endAddr)] in VarnodeCompareLocDef order; the ctor do-while breaks at parentType==ct and falls through when getSubType returns null; constructTypedPointer's while(baseType!=charType) continue-on-array-element-0 skips the trailing curOff=newOff (constseq.cc:307); removeForward walks each output's descend list with the PIECE xref double-visit merge.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: collectCopyOps's diff starts at rootAddr-startAddr and advances only on tmpDiff-diff==charAlignSize (gap > alignSize breaks, previous element returns false); lastOff records the innermost array offset; numBytes is moveOps.size()*charType->getSize() (constseq.cc:351), not numElements; formByteArray's count allows exactly one trailing null terminator.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: checkInterference sorts moveOps by op SeqNum order; the ctor's parentType==ct and constructTypedPointer's loop guard are Datatype pointer identity compares (Rugra Arc::ptr_eq plus name/size fallback); the queryContainer bridge takes the smallest containing entry (strictly-smaller rule with exact-size short-circuit).
